enable_host_guest_stack_synchronization.description: Records entries for guest/host stack mappings at function starts and checks for reentry at return sites. Has slight performance impact, but fixes crashes in games that use setjmp/longjmp.

use_fast_dot_product.name: use_fast_dot_product
use_fast_dot_product.description: Experimental optimization, much shorter sequence on dot products, treating inf as overflow instead of using mcxsrfour insn dotprod

no_round_to_single.name: no_round_to_single
no_round_to_single.description: Not for users, breaks games. Skip rounding double values to single precision and back

inline_loadclock.name: inline_loadclock
inline_loadclock.description: Directly read cached guest clock without calling the LoadClock method (it gets repeatedly updated by calls from other threads)

delay_via_maybeyield.name: delay_via_maybeyield
delay_via_maybeyield.description: implement the db16cyc instruction via MaybeYield, may improve scheduling of guest threads

a64_max_stackpoints.name: a64_max_stackpoints
a64_max_stackpoints.description: Max number of host->guest stack mappings we can record.

a64_enable_host_guest_stack_synchronizat.name: a64_enable_host_guest_stack_synchronization
a64_enable_host_guest_stack_synchronizat.description: Records entries for guest/host stack mappings at function starts and checks for reentry at return sites. Has slight performance impact, but fixes crashes in games that use setjmp/longjmp.

inline_mmio_access.name: inline_mmio_access
inline_mmio_access.description: Inline constant MMIO loads and stores.

permit_float_constant_evaluation.name: permit_float_constant_evaluation
permit_float_constant_evaluation.description: Allow float constant evaluation, may produce incorrect results and break games math

store_all_context_values.name: store_all_context_values
store_all_context_values.description: Don't strip dead context stores to aid in debugging.

full_optimization_even_with_debug.name: full_optimization_even_with_debug
full_optimization_even_with_debug.description: For developer use to analyze the quality of the generated code, not intended for actual debugging of the code

allow_plugins.name: allow_plugins
allow_plugins.description: Allows loading of plugins/trainers from plugins\title_id\plugin.xex. Plugin are homebrew xex modules which can be used for making mods. This feature is experimental.

use_dedicated_xma_thread.name: use_dedicated_xma_thread

left_stick_deadzone_percentage.description: Defines deadzone level for left stick. Allowed range [0.0-1.0].

right_stick_deadzone_percentage.description: Defines deadzone level for right stick. Allowed range [0.0-1.0].

cvar_name.description: List of keys to bind to , separated by spaces

x64_extension_mask.description:
Allow the detection and utilization of specific instruction set features.
    0 = x86_64 + AVX1
    1 = AVX2
    2 = FMA
    4 = LZCNT
    8 = BMI1
   16 = BMI2

  512 = AVX512VL

profiler_dpi_scaling.name: profiler_dpi_scaling
profiler_dpi_scaling.description: Apply window DPI scaling to the profiler.

threading_blocking_waitany.name: threading_blocking_waitany
threading_blocking_waitany.description: Candidate fix (default off = current 1ms poll): make WaitMultiple(WaitAny) event-driven instead of polling. Waiters register a latched wait-block with each handle; a handle's Signal hands the wake to one registered waiter under lock (auto-reset consumed exactly once), so a sub-millisecond Set-then-Reset transient is no longer lost (the DOA5 worker-pool deadlock). WaitAll still uses the poll. Regression-check broadly before shipping.

macos_thread_cancel_mode.name: macos_thread_cancel_mode
macos_thread_cancel_mode.description: macOS diagnostic probe for guest-thread teardown. async is current behavior. deferred prevents pthread cancellation from landing at arbitrary instructions; it may convert heap corruption into a hang if a guest thread never reaches a cancellation point. Diagnostic only, not a shippable fix.

clock_no_scaling.name: clock_no_scaling
clock_no_scaling.description: Disable scaling code. Time management and locking is bypassed. Guest system time is directly pulled from host.

clock_source_raw.name: clock_source_raw
clock_source_raw.description: On x64, Use the RDTSC instruction as the time source. Requires invariant TSC. On a64, Use the CNTVCT_EL0 register as the time source

a64_extension_mask.name: a64_extension_mask
a64_extension_mask.description:
Allow the detection and utilization of specific instruction set features.
    0 = armv8.0
    1 = Large System Extensions(LSE) atomic operations
    2 = FPCR.FZ flushes denormal inputs (skip software flush)
   -1 = Detect and utilize all possible processor features

log_to_logcat.name: log_to_logcat
log_to_logcat.description: Write log output to Android Logcat.

log_file.name: log_file
log_file.description: Logs are written to the given file

flush_log.name: flush_log
flush_log.description: Flush log file after each log line batch.

log_mask.name: log_mask
log_mask.description: Disables specific categorizes for more granular debug logging. Kernel = 1, Apu = 2, Cpu = 4, Gpu = 8.

writable_executable_memory.name: writable_executable_memory
writable_executable_memory.description: Allow mapping memory with both write and execute access, for simulating behavior on platforms where that's not supported

guest_thread_qos.name: guest_thread_qos
guest_thread_qos.description: macOS only: Apple QoS scheduling policy for guest CPU threads. 'off' (default, no QoS calls) | 'all' (every guest XThread) | 'main' (entry-point thread only) | 'priority' (guest priority >= guest_thread_qos_priority_threshold). 'hot' (hot-after-warmup) is reserved but not yet implemented.

guest_thread_qos_class.name: guest_thread_qos_class
guest_thread_qos_class.description: macOS only: QoS class applied when guest_thread_qos selects a thread: 'user_initiated' (default) | 'user_interactive'.

guest_thread_qos_priority_threshold.name: guest_thread_qos_priority_threshold
guest_thread_qos_priority_threshold.description: macOS only: with guest_thread_qos=priority, tag guest threads whose guest priority is >= this value.

guest_wait_profile.name: guest_wait_profile
guest_wait_profile.description: CPU-perf analysis (Layer 1 Piece B): per-guest-thread wait attribution. Counts and times object blocking (event/mutant/semaphore/timer) vs Sleep(0)/yield spin-polling, and records which objects each thread blocks on. Dumped to the log at emulator shutdown. Default off (zero steady-state cost). Use it to find WHAT a dependency-bound guest thread waits on.

stack_size_multiplier_hack.name: stack_size_multiplier_hack
stack_size_multiplier_hack.description: A hack for games with setjmp/longjmp issues.

main_xthread_stack_size_multiplier_hack.name: main_xthread_stack_size_multiplier_hack
main_xthread_stack_size_multiplier_hack.description: A hack for games with setjmp/longjmp issues.

spin0_sleep_us.name: spin0_sleep_us
spin0_sleep_us.description: Diagnostic / candidate fix (default 0 = current MaybeYield): when a guest thread calls KeDelayExecutionThread(0)/Sleep(0) (non-alertable, the busy poll-loop yield), do a real NanoSleep of this many microseconds instead of sched_yield. Throttles the DOA5 load-stall poll loops that spam NtSetEvent and contend the kernel locks/scheduler. Try 100. Revert/redesign before any fix ships.

macos_spin0_backoff_us.name: macos_spin0_backoff_us
macos_spin0_backoff_us.description: macOS-only: adaptive busy-poll backoff. The guest's lock-free pump loops spam Sleep(0); on POSIX that is sched_yield, which keeps the spinner runnable and on Apple Silicon's asymmetric scheduler starves the guest job dispatcher (the DOA5 load-stall freeze). After a short burst of cheap yields, a runaway Sleep(0) spinner instead sleeps this many microseconds so the dispatcher gets the core. 0 disables (pure sched_yield, pre-fix behavior). 250 is the validated value; tune via 100/250/500.

macos_spin0_depress.name: macos_spin0_depress
macos_spin0_depress.description: macOS-only: the Sleep(0) backoff gives the core away with a priority-depressing thread_switch (any runnable thread runs first, and the spinner resumes at once when none is waiting) instead of sleeping macos_spin0_backoff_us. A fixed sleep wakes a guest frame limiter that polls the performance counter between Sleep(0)s up to one slice late, and limiters that restart from the late time (Ultra Street Fighter IV) drift below 60 fps. false restores the sleep.

io_ledger_diag.name: io_ledger_diag
io_ledger_diag.description: Diagnostic (default off): async-I/O completion ledger for the DOA5 load-stall hunt. Logs NtCreateFile opens and NtReadFile issues (path, offset, length, sync, event, APC routine/context, io_status_block, thid/LR, bytes/status), tracks completion-APC queued-vs-delivered, and on the spin detector dumps outstanding (queued-but-undelivered) completion APCs older than a threshold. Goal: find an issued read whose completion is never delivered, or prove all I/O completed (then the queue waits on a non-I/O job). Revert before any fix.

delay_poll_diag.name: delay_poll_diag
delay_poll_diag.description: Diagnostic (default off): when a guest thread spins calling KeDelayExecutionThread from the shared Sleep helper (DOA5 next-level load livelock), dump ONCE per (tid, immediate-LR) after a repeat threshold: the Sleep helper's CALLER LR (the poll loop, read from the saved-LR slot [r1+0x68]) + a stack-return scan + a disasm window around that caller (the polled flag's load/compare/branch). Revert before any fix.

dispatcher_diag.name: dispatcher_diag
dispatcher_diag.description: Diagnostic (default off; run WITH --delay_poll_diag for the freeze detector and --io_ledger_diag for the per-event signal summary). DOA5 load-stall producer/dispatcher probe. QUEUE-FIRST: at the shared Sleep helper, the polled object's magic [+0x40]=='LfQu' (0x4C665175) is the authoritative dispatcher identity; record (queue head/tail/seq + poll-loop PC/LR) into a change-triggered ring (push only on state change, so the ring spans the whole stall). On the spin freeze, dump the ring PLUS an all-thread live-LR snapshot + disasm window (captures a dispatcher stuck in an ldarx/stdcx CAS loop that never crosses Sleep, which the ring alone cannot see). Classify the live PC: drain-wait 8283811C (A) / new select routine (B) / 82880020-style CAS (C). Event-signal identity (io_ledger sigsum) is SECONDARY, cross-referenced by tid. Capture-only; revert before any fix.
